page.overview:
What is Isles of Nariel?

The Isles of Nariel are a fictional archipelago created by the late American author Howard Phillips Lovecraft for his 1920 short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath."

A group of islands located in the Middle Ocean in the Dreamlands, peacocks from the islands were considered a delicacy in Sarnath. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
